_comment: Pinned ids for the FIGURE-TRIAGE.md `add` rows. An add-row has no identifier in the triage table (its fragment column is literally an em dash), but the desk stores the author's rulings on undrawn candidates under an id, so the id has to be stable across regenerations. Key = chapter|section|first six words of the idea. `page`/`pageNote` are curated judgements: a page is given only where a checkable link to an existing figure's page justifies it, otherwise the desk says 'page unknown' rather than guessing. build_figure_desk.py reports any key that lost its pin and any pin that lost its key.
